summary.text: Stewart Barlow is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 17 in Davis County, serving since his appointment on September 1, 2011. The Legislature's roster lists him as a physician and surgeon.

paragraphs.text: The Legislature's profile says Barlow graduated from the University of Utah with a B.S. in psychology and earned a medical degree from Georgetown University.
It says he completed a general surgery internship at Washington Medical Center and a residency in otolaryngology, head and neck surgery at Georgetown University Hospital.
Barlow serves as a board-certified otolaryngologist and is president of Service Mortgage Corporation and vice president of Barlow Corporation and Dale Corporation, according to the profile.
The profile says he and his wife, Marie, have lived in Fruit Heights for more than 20 years and have six children and nine grandchildren.
